event_description: Start your summer adventure at the Duluth Children's Museum by exploring the Adventure Climber, our newest exhibit! Climbers traverse over and under, around and through while exploring the Adventure Climber. Children burn off steam by following their curiosity across bridges, through tunnels, up ramps, over obstacles, and into secret passageways. The Adventure Climber reveals amazing sites and delightful discoveries at every turn! Join us for the grand opening of this locally constructed exhibit on Saturday, May 20th from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Regular admission applies, which is $10 for children and adults and free for infants under 12 months and DCM members. Admission also lets you play all day at the Duluth Children's Museum, with an entire floor of indoor educational exhibits exploring art, engineering, imaginative play and more.

event_description: Support kids by being a kid as the museum hosts A Night at the Brewseum on Saturday, October 18, 2025 from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m, this year at the Saint Louis County Depot! This unique event features a fun night for grown-ups to discover the science behind brewing and explore the programs and services of the museum. Taste delicious craft brews from twin ports breweries and chat with brewing experts as you drink & play! Admission includes: Souvenir tasting glass Beer/Cider/Spirit Samples from local breweries including: Earth Rider Brewery, Duluth Cider, Vikre Distillery, Wild State Cider, Warrior Brewing, Ursa Minor Brewing, Super One Liquor Food Trucks: Oasis del Norte Live Music with the Trash Cats Silent Auction Ticketed Activities and endless fun! Tickets: General ($45) At door *if available, tickets are limited* ($50) Must be 21 to attend. IDs checked at the door. Sponsored by: Maurices, Super One, Northern Door & Hardware, and J3 Insurance. LOCATION: Saint Louis County Depot, 506 W Michigan St, Duluth, MN 55802. SAMPLES: Must present ID at the door (21+). Attendees receive 1 souvenir glass with ticket. FUNDRAISER: Funds raised for A Night at the Brewseum, will directly benefit the Duluth Children’s Museum’s new home in Lincoln Park and programs benefiting families with the most need. The DCM provides an accessible and safe year-round indoor space where all children and their families can learn through play, and provides over 400 families a year with free memberships. The Duluth Children’s Museum’s mission is to engage children in hands on learning through creative play and interactive exhibits. The museum’s goal is to make educational experiences in arts, culture, history, and STEM accessible to all children. Purchase Tickets Now
